description: This file defines a custom exception class SwfException for handling errors related to the Amazon Simple Workflow Service (SWF) within the AWS SDK for PHP. It extends the base AwsException class and is used for error handling specific to SWF interactions.

classes.name: SwfException
classes.description: A specific exception class for errors encountered when interacting with Amazon SWF, extending the general AwsException.

methods.name: SwfException::__construct
methods.description: Inherits the constructor from AwsException, instantiated when an error occurs during SWF operations.
